top.line: SGit, SHarness, ABP, RiskMandate and AgentiCCells as one stack of separate companies, with real usage.
top.para: One ladder of offers on every site, and a plan to align them.

in-short.line: The stack, the missing first step, the factory, real usage, one ladder, alignment.

why.line: Real customers, usage and examples now, and the factory removed the last manual piece.
why.para: An intersection of companies that goes end to end.

foundations.line: SGit vaults and lanes, SHarness kernel-enforced process policies, and a key for every person and agent.
foundations.para: SGit's public examples: the summit and OmKneeHealth.

abp.line: Agent Behaviour Policies: grant, mandate, gap and barrier, housed at RiskMandate for now.
abp.para: Published at Web Summit, 45 roles on PrompTugal.news, and now pipelines.

riskmandate.line: RiskMandate sells ABPs from £10 to £1,500; what it lacked was an easy first step.
riskmandate.para: Its use case is the summit.

agenticcells.line: AgentiCCells sells agentic teams as cells from £500, using RiskMandate's policies and SGit's vaults.
agenticcells.para: The factory makes delivery a commit away.

uses.line: PrompTugal.news, the Web Summit team, the factory's sites, five apps, VoiceDebrief, OmKneeHealth and this newsroom.
uses.para: Each uses the layers below; no money changes hands.

ladder.line: Every site sells on the same ladder: £500, £1,500, £5,000 and £20,000.
ladder.para: Each company sells its own thing at each step.

companies.line: Each is a separate company with its own buyers, from developers to CISOs to local businesses.

plan.line: Every site: one line, the stack, the ladder, examples, links, articles, a contact.
plan.para: And a first showcase for SHarness.

limits.line: No money between companies; most prices proposals; ticks only where evidenced; legal structure not described.

sources.line: The live sites and the PrompTugal, AgentiCCells and iOS repositories.
